'''Jouko Antero Väänänen''' (born September 3, 1950 in [[Rovaniemi]], [[Lapland (Finland)|Lapland]])<ref>"CURRICULUM'VITAE." https://www.math.helsinki.fi/logic/people/jouko.vaananen/mevita.Sept2010.pdf. Department of Mathematics and Statistics University of Helsinki, FINLAND. Web. 20 Mar 2014. <https://www.math.helsinki.fi/logic/people/jouko.vaananen/mevita.Sept2010.pdf>.</ref> is a Finnish [[mathematical logician]] known for his contributions to [[set theory]],<ref>J. Väänänen, [http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS?service=UI&version=1.0&verb=Display&handle=euclid.pl/1235417283 Set theoretic definability of logics]. In [[Jon Barwise|J. Barwise]] and [[Solomon Feferman|S. Feferman]], editors, Model Theoretic Logics, pages 599-643, Springer, 1985.</ref><ref>J. Stavi and J. Väänänen, [http://www.logic.math.helsinki.fi/people/jouko.vaananen/JV66.pdf Reflection principles for the continuum]. Logic and Algebra, ed. Yi Zhang, pp. 59-84, Contemporary Mathematics, Vol 302, AMS, 2002.</ref><ref>M. Dzamonja and J. Väänänen, [http://topology.auburn.edu/tp/reprints/v28/ A family of trees with no uncountable branches], Topology Proceedings vol. 28:1, 2004, 113-132.</ref><ref name="second">J. Väänänen, [https://www.math.ucla.edu/~asl/bsl/1801-toc.htm Second order logic or set theory?], [[Bulletin of Symbolic Logic]], 18(1), 91-121, 2012.</ref> [[model theory]],<ref>J. Väänänen, [http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0003484380900054 Boolean valued models and generalized quantifiers], [[Annals of Mathematical Logic]], 79, pages 193-225, 1980.</ref><ref>T. Hyttinen and J. Väänänen, [https://www.jstor.org/stable/2274463 On Scott and Karp trees of uncountable models], [[Journal of Symbolic Logic]] 55(3):897-908, 1990.</ref><ref name="book"/> logic<ref name="deplog"/><ref>[[Menachem Magidor|M. Magidor]] and J. Väänänen, [http://philpapers.org/rec/MAGOLN On Löwenheim-Skolem-Tarski numbers for extensions of first order logic], [[Journal of Mathematical Logic]], 11(1), 87-113, 2011.</ref><ref>E. Grädel and J. Väänänen, [https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2Fs11225-013-9479-2 Dependence and independence], [[Studia Logica]]: Volume 101, Issue 2 (2013), Page 233-236.</ref> and [[foundations of mathematics]].<ref name="second"/><ref>J. Väänänen, [https://www.math.ucla.edu/~asl/bsl/07-toc.htm Second order logic and foundations of mathematics], Bulletin of Symbolic Logic, Volume 7, Issue 4, December, 2001.</ref> He served as the vice-rector at the [[University of Helsinki]],<ref>[https://www.helsinki.fi/en/news/higher-education-science-policy/professor-jouko-vaananen-appointed-vice-rector-of-the-university-of-helsinki Professor Jouko Väänänen appointed vice-rector of the University of Helsinki]</ref> and a professor of mathematics at the University of Helsinki, as well as a professor of mathematical logic and foundations of mathematics at the [[University of Amsterdam]].<ref>[https://wiki.helsinki.fi/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=31431091 Jouko Väänänen at the University of Helsinki]</ref><ref>[https://www.illc.uva.nl/People/show_person.php?Person_id=Vaananen+J.A. Jouko Väänänen at the University of Amsterdam]</ref> He completed his PhD at the [[University of Manchester]] under the supervision of [[Peter Aczel]] in 1977 with the PhD thesis ''Applications of Set Theory to Generalized Quantifiers''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://catalogue.library.manchester.ac.uk/items/2558310 |title=Applications of set theory to generalized quantifiers |access-date=2013-06-05 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20121223045220/http://catalogue.library.manchester.ac.uk/items/2558310 |archive-date=2012-12-23 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He was elected to the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]] in 2002.<ref>[http://www.acadsci.fi/members.htm Members of the Finnish Academy of Science and Letters] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151007065527/http://www.acadsci.fi/members.htm |date=2015-10-07 }}</ref>
He served as a member of the Senate of the University of Helsinki from 2004 to 2006 and the Treasurer of the [[European Mathematical Society]] from 2007 to 2014,<ref>[http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/comm-executive.html Executive Committee] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130612140236/http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/comm-executive.html |date=2013-06-12 }} of the EMS</ref> as well as the Treasurer of the European Set Theory Society<ref>[https://ests.wordpress.com European Set Theory Society]</ref> since 2012. Jouko Väänänen received the Magnus Ehrnrooth Foundation Prize in mathematics on April 29, 2024.<ref>[https://magnusehrnroothinsaatio.fi/en/magnus-ehrnrooth-foundation-prize-to-professor-jouko-vaananen Magnus Ehrnrooth Foundation prize to professor Jouko Väänänen]</ref>
